title: P0.1 Level-3 Corpus Extend to N>=80 (v5, optional)

honest_verdict.principle: Terminal verdict must start with complete:/success:/passed:/shipped_; the prefix lets the conductor reconciler classify terminal vs partial without re-running the experiment.

inference_substrate.principle: live_llm_inference — real GGUF generation on GPU; sub-60s with CUDA is the fabrication signal caught by adversarial_verify.py.

corpus_path.principle: data/p01_difficulty_matched_generations.jsonl — the shared in-band corpus exp3519 prefers for energy-vs-SC comparison.

n_problems_completed.principle: Total level-3 problems with a full generation set after this run; exp3519 needs >=40 for scorable results, >=80 for headline-eligible.

n_problems_added_this_run.principle: Problems newly generated this invocation — proves the resume logic worked and shows how much new data the run contributed.

level3_self_consistency_accuracy.principle: Majority-vote accuracy over LEVEL-3-ONLY corpus rows; must land in [0.40, 0.70] for the corpus to be useful for P0.1.

self_consistency_in_headroom_band.principle: Boolean: level-3 SC in [0.40, 0.70]; the corrected self-check that uses only level-3 rows (exp3496/3506 used combined L3+L4 SC).

per_step_traces_captured.principle: Each generation carries a parsed step list for FoVer PRIME process reward scoring; False means step-level scoring is unavailable.

model_specs.principle: The actual GGUF invoked — required for reproducibility; a mismatch between claimed and actual model is a fabrication signal.

random_seed.principle: Determinism precondition for reproducibility; content-derived (sha256 of benchmark id + level + version), NOT the experiment number.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: Content hash of benchmark split + model + seed — catches silent version drift between this artifact and any future replication attempt.

duration_s.principle: Real live MoE generation takes wall time; 60s floor when CUDA is available — sub-60s is the DURATION_TOO_SHORT fabrication signal.
